input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay obligation, minimum spend or minimum impression/volume requirement on AP. Fees are structured purely as a revenue share on advertising revenue actually generated through the Auction Platform (§5, p0023), with no shortfall or true-up mechanic, and §1 (p0001) expressly confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and does not restrict AP from selling Inventory through other agents or third parties. The only "minimum" references are a floor price AP itself sets for winning bids (p0014) and a disclaimer that no minimum revenue is guaranteed (p0062) — neither binds AP to purchase. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/ordered services only), so no redline is warranted.
